title: NOT CERTIFIED: long threads still lose their opening turns — the client FIFO-drops history past 60k chars before the runtime can fold it, so the summary starts mid-thread
repro: Candidate 633f8440. Chat with 6 exchanges whose answers are ~12k chars each (research-length). historyForSend (src/store/chat-history.ts:316-337, HISTORY_CHAR_BUDGET=60_000) sends 8 of 12 turns, and turn 1 is absent. agent_runtime._coerce_history folds 6, so the UI says 'Older turns summarised' but the summary begins at question 3. Second case: 20 exchanges of 3.5k chars sends 32 of 40, and turn 1 is again lost. The summary also carries no figures or sources, which the fix_shape required. The literal 7-turn short-thread acceptance case passes.

title: A Yahoo rate-limit on earnings history is swallowed as an empty history and cached for 24h
repro: On a throttled IP, ticker.earnings_history raises YFRateLimitError (INFY.NS, INFY and MSFT confirmed by eh.py). earnings_provider._fetch_history_sync:265-268 catches it, so history is None. GET /earnings/INFY/history then returns 200 history:[], which is cached under _TTL_HISTORY=24h, and the user sees 'no earnings history' for a day. /earnings/INFY/surprises and /fundamentals/INFY/ratings/history also came back empty under the same throttle.

title: A partially throttled screen shows 'No rows matched — loosen a threshold / Reset filters' although most symbols were never evaluated
repro: Live :52602, custom universe of 12 symbols, genuinely Yahoo-throttled: evaluated_count 3, 9 rate_limited, partial true. ScreenerResultsTable (:535) only shows the throttle message when evaluated_count===0. Otherwise rows.length===0 renders 'No rows matched the criteria / No stocks in this universe passed every filter. Loosen a threshold… / Reset filters', which blames the user's filters for a provider throttle.

title: A focused SEC Filings panel publishes 'identifier', not 'symbol', so the agent is told the chart's symbol is 'this'
repro: Setup: chart SPY; SEC Filings on AAPL, focused. SecFilingsPanel.tsx:170-178 publishes {identifier, formFilter, tab, filingCount}, and focusedSymbolFromBus (context-provider.ts:243) reads only symbol/ticker. Result: the snapshot's focusedSymbol is SPY (chart fallback), there are no symbol chips, and the badge reads 'Context: sec-filings'. The preamble renders 'When the user says "this"… they mean SPY'.

title: Agent save_screen overwrites the user's live screener draft (criteria, group, formula) without saying so, and Undo does not restore it
repro: Setup: the user's on-screen draft is dividend_yield>0.03 with formula 'roe > 0.2'. Accepting save_screen {name, group, formula} writes the agent's recipe into the draft before saving (host-actions.ts save_screen apply). The diff mentions only saved screens. Undo restores the replaced saved screen, but the draft stays the agent's recipe (pe<9, formula ''), so the user's unsaved filters and formula are silently lost.

title: _us_isin caches a definite ISIN miss for the life of the process (same stale-negative class DATA-097 fixed for live lookup)
repro: symbol_resolver._us_isin (:672) stores a negative result with no TTL. A US listing whose ISIN becomes resolvable after the first miss keeps resolving without an ISIN until the sidecar restarts. By contrast, _live_lookup now expires empty results after _LIVE_EMPTY_TTL_SECONDS=300.

title: CONTRIBUTING.md still says 'Python 3.13+' while the build now requires exactly 3.13
repro: CONTRIBUTING.md:26 lists 'Python 3.13+'. build-python.mjs refuses any other minor version, so a contributor with only 3.14 follows the doc and then hits 'No Python 3.13 found'.
